points.description: Names dust particles, or clay minerals (which are a type of dust particle), as a material that nucleates ice crystals. Equivalent wording such as 'mineral dust' or 'soil dust' earns the mark.

Names organic material (organic particles) and ocean salts (sea salt) as materials that nucleate ice crystals. Full mark for both; 0.5 for naming either organic material or ocean/sea salt alone. Equivalent wording such as 'sea salt' or 'salt particles from the ocean' earns the mark.
points.partial_credit: 0.5 for naming only one of organic material or ocean/sea salt.
